coverage_note: Asserts the check-layer behaviour this fixture was authored for. Recognition-dependent checks are deliberately not asserted here; they belong to the phase that implements them.
notes: An apparel product stating one product-scope attribute whose taxonomy row declares no PARTIAL condition, and nothing else. APPAREL.CLOSURE_AND_CONSTRUCTION must reach PASS at its full 1.65 on presence alone, quoted at attributes[closure_and_construction].value_raw, with confidence high on the structural arm. No finding may assert what the supplied value means: satisfies is VALUE_PRESENT, so no predicate runs and none may be introduced to make this fixture pass. Every other apparel attribute must reach UNKNOWN with checked_paths, zero earned and zero penalty.

products.forbidden_status_reason: Nothing is present to be wrong. PRD 7.3: FAIL is reserved for things present and defective; absence is UNKNOWN.
products.penalty_reason: D-003: missing information forfeits its points and never subtracts.

expected_findings_include.reason: A stated, non-placeholder structured value settles a value_present row on presence alone (taxonomy.md 5.1; registry.CheckDef.satisfaction is NO_PREDICATE).
